summary: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. filed an 8-K to report a secured debt refinancing of a collateralized loan obligation (CLO) by its consolidated subsidiary Owl Rock CLO XI, LLC on April 27, 2026. The transaction involved issuing $122 million of rated notes (Class A-R and Class B-R) and borrowing $150 million under floating-rate loan facilities, totaling $395.82 million in new debt, used to redeem prior notes and preferred shares. This is a routine refinancing of existing financing structures, not a special situation event. No consideration per share, premium, or deal terms apply. The filing is a standard material definitive agreement, not actionable as a special situation.
